The proposed name change is included in both House and Senate versions of the annual defense-policy bill, but Democrats are pushing to remove it during negotiations.

The nuclear-armed warships, designed to carry lasers, railguns and hypersonic missiles, could cost up to $23 billion for the first ship, according to the Congressional Budget Office.
